claim: Amazon S3 can send event notification messages to SNS topics, SQS queues, Lambda functions and Amazon EventBridge. You specify the destination ARN in the notification configuration.
question: Which destinations can receive S3 event notifications?

values.display: Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topics
Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queues

evidence.quote: Amazon S3 can send event notification messages to the following destinations. You specify the Amazon Resource Name (ARN) value of these destinations in the notification configuration. Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topics Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queues AWS Lambda function Amazon EventBridge

claim: Only a standard SNS topic is allowed as an S3 event notification destination. An SNS FIFO topic is not allowed.
question: Can an SNS FIFO topic be an S3 event notification destination?

evidence.quote: Currently, Standard SNS is only allowed as an S3 event notification destination, whereas SNS FIFO is not allowed.

claim: An SNS topic, an SQS queue or a Lambda function used as an S3 event notification destination must be in the same Region as the S3 bucket.
question: In which Region must the destination of an S3 event notification be?

values.display: The topic must be in the same AWS Region
same AWS Region as your Amazon S3 bucket
same Region as your S3 bucket

evidence.quote: The topic must be in the same AWS Region as your Amazon S3 bucket.
The Amazon SQS queue must be in the same AWS Region as your Amazon S3 bucket.
The Lambda function must be in the same Region as your S3 bucket.

claim: You must grant Amazon S3 permission to post messages to an SNS topic or an SQS queue, and permission to invoke a Lambda function on your behalf.
question: What permissions must the destination of an S3 event notification grant to Amazon S3?

values.display: grant Amazon S3 permissions to post messages
permission to invoke an AWS Lambda function

evidence.quote: You must grant Amazon S3 permissions to post messages to an Amazon SNS topic or an Amazon SQS queue. You must also grant Amazon S3 permission to invoke an AWS Lambda function on your behalf.

claim: SQS FIFO queues are not supported as an S3 event notification destination. To send an S3 event notification to an SQS FIFO queue, use Amazon EventBridge.
question: How can an S3 event notification reach an SQS FIFO queue?

evidence.quote: Amazon Simple Queue Service FIFO (First-In-First-Out) queues aren't supported as an Amazon S3 event notification destination. To send a notification for an Amazon S3 event to an Amazon SQS FIFO queue, you can use Amazon EventBridge.

claim: S3 event notification messages can be up to 64 KB, so set the queue's MaximumMessageSize to at least 64 KB. If a notification is larger than the queue's MaximumMessageSize, SQS rejects it and does not deliver the event.
question: What happens if an S3 event notification is larger than the SQS queue's MaximumMessageSize?

values.display: notification messages can be up to 64 KB

evidence.quote: Amazon S3 event notification messages can be up to 64 KB. We recommend that you set the queue's MaximumMessageSize attribute to at least 64 KB. If an event notification exceeds the queue's configured MaximumMessageSize, Amazon SQS rejects the notification and doesn't deliver the event.

claim: You can enable or disable event delivery to EventBridge for a bucket. If you enable it, all events are sent to EventBridge, and EventBridge rules can route them to additional targets.
question: How do you turn on S3 events for EventBridge, and which events are sent?

values.display: disable events to be delivered to EventBridge
all events are sent to EventBridge

evidence.quote: Unlike other destinations, you can either enable or disable events to be delivered to EventBridge for a bucket. If you enable delivery, all events are sent to EventBridge. Moreover, you can use EventBridge rules to route events to additional targets.

claim: After you enable EventBridge for an S3 bucket, it takes around five minutes for the change to take effect.
question: How long after you enable EventBridge on an S3 bucket do events start to flow?

values.display: for the changes to take effect

evidence.quote: After you enable EventBridge, it takes around five minutes for the changes to take effect.
